**sdd/issue-576-archetypes/design**

Full files: openspec/changes/issue-576-archetypes/{specs/role-archetypes/spec.md, design.md, tasks.md} (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-576).

Spec: 6 requirements — archetype owns ONLY {archetype, escalation, output_contract} with labels strictly mechanical|doctrinal (checked values, #499); the four archetypes by write/see axes, the Adversary seed re-seats with unchanged served surface; the Verifier reviewer instance cites §2's locks BY SYMBOL; projection byte-deterministic + drift-guarded + `brain-` namespaced (claude .claude/agents/brain-<role>.md; antigravity via compileAgentsMd(docs, {roles}) additive param with backward byte-identity); challenger calls the port (binding deleted, AXIS half byte-untouched); ADR-0023 signed via Ruta A with jd-* D3 reason inside.

Design: T1 archetypes.mjs + firstPartyInstance(name) second door; T2 verifier-review.mjs (no protocol literals); T3 project-role.mjs (model OMITTED from frontmatter — tier/chooses belong to routing not the projected file; emission wiring + managed-paths = ADR NOTE, the maintainer's hand, never silent); T4 challenger.{agent,model} config keys become UNREAD-and-documented-inert (#229 post-release doctrine, no migration deletes them); T5 ADR drafted LAST from what exists.

Tasks: single PR ~640 countable vs 1000 — no chain, no pre-apply decision. 1.8 is the maintainer's ceremony: brain:promote the ADR on the branch + decision label. Closes #576 and #754.
